text: New game: DREAM screen stayed completely black (only menu + Skip button) for ~15 s real time; tick only reached 24 (tps very low on shared machine). No loading indicator.

Run key set to 'Press to toggle'. After tapping Shift in game there is no on-screen sign that run is on or off (no icon, the controls hint never mentions Shift/run), and state.player.speed stays 2.2. Could not confirm toggle changed speed at ~10 tps.

Rebinds work in game: Walk forward W->I, Use E->F. W no longer moves, E no longer uses, I walks, F looks out of porthole (WREN line fires). The on-screen hint updates to 'I A ↓ D ... F to use things' - nice.

Could not reach any console to check Console text size = Larger: at ~5-10 game ticks/s (load avg ~129) walking from quarters toward the archive console made almost no progress in the time budget. Also: pt walkto presses W, so it cannot move after W is rebound.
